steps.name: reachability/auth check before any collection is created
index 3-5 multilingual documents through embedForIndex() (real inference descriptors)
real max-input check: the deliberately over-long document is rejected by checkEmbedInputFits() BEFORE any upsert
upsert points with vector: {dense, sparse} inference descriptors (full vector set per point)
confirm points contain both named vectors (dense present; sparse present when profile declares one)
run a Ukrainian query through runHybridSearch() (real Query API call)
hybrid results map to the standard Chunk shape (toChunk() output)
confirm Cloud Inference was used, not local ONNX/Ollama (throw-if-called sentinel never fired)
resolveExistingCollectionProfile() resolves the canonical qdrant-cloud profile afterward (round-trip)
Tier 2 probeInference() confirms Cloud Inference genuinely works for this model
